name: How Tech Works
disclaimer: Animations are simplified illustrations, not exact to scale.

look.style: 3D studio explainer: lit objects on a dark stage, cutaways, exploded parts, dives through scales, labels on the parts, one accent colour

note: Written by the /new-channel build phase from research/advice.md and style-study/2026-11-18-references.md. generator/pack.py reads it.

motion._why: the references' camera never stops; viewers leave on still frames

sound._why: measured on the references 2026-11-18 (style-study/2026-11-18-references.md): dark ambient-electronic bed ~24 dB under the voice, ~12 dB duck, 12 effects a minute in Shorts and 6 in long videos, machine sounds only, a drop before each reveal. Levels checked on a Kokoro build: bedLevel 0.22 + duck 0.8 = 23.6 dB (Short) and 25.5 dB (long) under the voice, a 12.3-12.6 dB duck

length._why: research 2026-11-18 (advice.md, style.json): the references' zoom Shorts run 56-60 s (median 72 s across 19); long hits 12-16 min, 600-900 s band 19% hits; owner 2026-11-18: long videos 8 min at most (render time)

samples._why: owner 2026-11-18: for this niche one sample is enough

voiceSpeed._why: research 2026-11-18 (style.json): references speak ~151 words a minute in Shorts, ~158 long; comments praise a calm narrator. Kokoro speaks ~164 words a minute per unit of speed
